verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer docs say Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline and others run as native chat backends. A dedicated use case covers supervising a coding agent, showing every file read and edit, with Allow/Deny approvals. Parallel agents can run one per git worktree, and scheduled tasks can run the test suite, so editing and testing repo work are documented beyond chat snippets. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of repo cloning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the coding-agent integration.
